name: Vologda Oblast (Russia)

colors.symbolism: the fly stripe and the arms

description: A white field with a red vertical stripe at the fly; in the upper hoist the coat of arms of Vologda Oblast (a hand emerging from a cloud holding a golden orb and silver sword, on red).
history: The flag of Vologda Oblast was adopted on 11 June 1996. The arms reproduce the historic 18th-century arms of Vologda, with a hand emerging from clouds holding a sword and an orb.
